result.title: Serving-Aligned Entire-Space Conversion Modeling via Click-Through Rate Knowledge Distillation
result.summary: Recommendation systems may use predicted click-through conversion rate (pCTCVR), the product of predicted click-through rate (pCTR) and post-click conversion rate (pCVR), to guide ranking decisions. Many pCVR models build on the Entire Space Multi-Task Model (ESMM), which jointly trains pCVR and auxiliary pCTR towers using pCTR and pCTCVR losses, but deploys only the pCVR tower. At serving time, this tower may be paired with a separately trained pCTR model, creating a training-serving mismatch in pCTCVR when its predictions differ from those of the auxiliary pCTR tower. In this paper, we use knowledge distillation (KD) from logged serving pCTR scores to supervise ESMM's auxiliary pCTR tower and improve training-serving pCTCVR alignment. We denote variants by KD-$α$, where $α$ controls the hard-label loss weight. On the Ali-CCP dataset, KD-0.3, the best variant on serving pCTCVR, increases ROC-AUC not only for serving pCTCVR but also for pCVR by 2.1% and 1.6%, respectively, and PR-AUC by 9.9% and 8.8%, respectively, relative to the ESMM baseline. We also test negative downsampling with 5% nonclick retention. Downsampled KD-0.3 increases mean AUC for serving pCTCVR and pCVR by 1.2% and 0.9%, respectively, -and PR-AUC by 8.5% and 4.5%, respectively, relative to downsampled ESMM.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文针对推荐系统中 ESMM 的 pCVR 塔与线上独立 pCTR 模型之间的训练—服务不一致，用线上 pCTR 分数对辅助 pCTR 塔做知识蒸馏，以对齐线上 pCTCVR 预估，并在 Ali-CCP 上验证效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于推荐系统多任务预估的工程性对齐问题，虽涉及知识蒸馏与辅助塔监督，但无视觉/多模态输入、无推理期 latent 状态生成，也未涉及证据获取或停止决策，与 LVR 主线缺少可迁移的具体线索。
